reason: Violates traverse-contracts' own EventContract identity invariant (id must equal namespace + "." + name): namespace="core", name="status-transitioned", but id="core.action-item.status-transitioned" instead of the required "core.status-transitioned". A strict EventRegistry::register load (e.g. traverse-cli serve --registry-state) rejects this record outright. See registry#324.
